title: Customer support handover
passage: Starting next week, all technical support cases must include the device serial number, software version, and steps taken before the problem occurred. This will help the engineering team investigate without repeatedly requesting basic information. Do not ask customers to send passwords. For cases involving unexpected shutdowns, also request the event log if it can be exported safely. The new form is on the support portal. A fifteen-minute walkthrough will be held online this Thursday at ten.
passageZh: 從下週開始，所有技術支援案件都必須包含裝置序號、軟體版本，以及問題發生前的操作步驟。這能幫助工程團隊調查，避免反覆索取基本資訊。請勿要求客戶寄送密碼。涉及非預期關機的案件，如果能安全匯出，也請索取事件紀錄。新表單放在支援入口網站。本星期四十點會在線上進行十五分鐘的操作導覽。
